project.name: Pairion Native Piper
project.description: Builds Piper TTS from source via CMake, generates FFM bindings via jextract, packages native library and espeak-ng-data as classpath resources

arguments.argument:
set -e
PIPER_SRC="${piper.src}" PIPER_BUILD="${piper.build}" NATIVE_SOURCES="${project.basedir}/src/main/native" CMAKE_PATCH="${project.basedir}/src/main/cmake/piper_shared_append.cmake"
# ── 1. Clone piper if not already present ──────────────────────────────────── if [ ! -d "${PIPER_SRC}/.git" ]; then git clone --recurse-submodules --depth 1 \ --branch ${piper.tag} \ https://github.com/rhasspy/piper.git "${PIPER_SRC}" echo "Cloned piper ${piper.tag}" else echo "Piper source already present at ${PIPER_SRC}" fi
# ── 2. Copy C wrapper files ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── cp "${NATIVE_SOURCES}/piper_c.h" "${PIPER_SRC}/src/cpp/piper_c.h" cp "${NATIVE_SOURCES}/piper_c.cpp" "${PIPER_SRC}/src/cpp/piper_c.cpp" echo "C wrapper files copied to ${PIPER_SRC}/src/cpp/"
# ── 3. Patch CMakeLists.txt (idempotent) ────────────────────────────────────── if ! grep -q "piper_shared" "${PIPER_SRC}/CMakeLists.txt"; then cat "${CMAKE_PATCH}" >> "${PIPER_SRC}/CMakeLists.txt" echo "Patched CMakeLists.txt with piper_shared target" else echo "CMakeLists.txt already patched" fi
# ── 4. CMake configure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── cmake -B "${PIPER_BUILD}" \ -S "${PIPER_SRC}" \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release echo "CMake configured"
# ── 5. Build piper_shared target ────────────────────────────────────────────── NCPU=$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 4) cmake --build "${PIPER_BUILD}" \ --config Release \ --target piper_shared \ -j${NCPU} echo "piper_shared target built"
# ── 6. Locate the built library ─────────────────────────────────────────────── PIPER_LIB=$(find "${PIPER_BUILD}" \ \( -name 'libpiper.dylib' -o -name 'libpiper.so' \) \ -not -type l \ -not -path '*/dSYM/*' \ 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "${PIPER_LIB}" ]; then echo "ERROR: libpiper shared library not found in ${PIPER_BUILD}" exit 1 fi echo "Found piper library: ${PIPER_LIB}"
# ── 7. Determine target platform directory ──────────────────────────────────── UNAME_S=$(uname -s) UNAME_M=$(uname -m) case "${UNAME_S}-${UNAME_M}" in Darwin-arm64) PLAT_DIR="darwin-aarch64" ;; Darwin-x86_64) PLAT_DIR="darwin-x86_64" ;; Linux-x86_64) PLAT_DIR="linux-x86_64" ;; Linux-aarch64) PLAT_DIR="linux-aarch64" ;; *) PLAT_DIR="unknown" ;; esac
DEST="${project.build.outputDirectory}/native/${PLAT_DIR}" mkdir -p "${DEST}"
# Installed phonemize libs live in ${PIPER_BUILD}/pi/lib/ PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR="${PIPER_BUILD}/pi/lib"
# ── 8. Copy dylibs with canonical SONAME filenames ──────────────────────────── if [ "${UNAME_S}" = "Darwin" ]; then # Copy real files (not symlinks) and rename to the SONAME expected by @rpath refs cp "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}/libonnxruntime.1.14.1.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libonnxruntime.1.14.1.dylib" cp "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}/libespeak-ng.1.52.0.1.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libespeak-ng.1.dylib" cp "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}/libpiper_phonemize.1.2.0.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib" cp "${PIPER_LIB}" "${DEST}/libpiper.dylib"
echo "Copied dylibs to ${DEST}"
# ── 9. Fix install IDs to plain filenames ───────────────────────────────── install_name_tool -id "libonnxruntime.1.14.1.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libonnxruntime.1.14.1.dylib" install_name_tool -id "libespeak-ng.1.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libespeak-ng.1.dylib" install_name_tool -id "libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib" install_name_tool -id "libpiper.dylib" \ "${DEST}/libpiper.dylib"
# ── 10. Fix libpiper_phonemize: replace absolute rpaths with @loader_path ─ for RPATH in $(otool -l "${DEST}/libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib" \ | grep -A2 LC_RPATH | grep "path " | awk '{print $2}'); do install_name_tool -delete_rpath "$RPATH" \ "${DEST}/libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib" 2>/dev/null || true done install_name_tool -add_rpath "@loader_path" \ "${DEST}/libpiper_phonemize.1.dylib"
# ── 11. Fix libpiper: remove absolute rpaths, ensure @loader_path is set ── for RPATH in $(otool -l "${DEST}/libpiper.dylib" \ | grep -A2 LC_RPATH | grep "path " \ | grep -v "@loader_path" | awk '{print $2}'); do install_name_tool -delete_rpath "$RPATH" \ "${DEST}/libpiper.dylib" 2>/dev/null || true done # Add @loader_path rpath so @rpath/libX.dylib deps resolve to the same dir install_name_tool -add_rpath "@loader_path" \ "${DEST}/libpiper.dylib" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Fixed dylib install names and rpaths"
elif [ "${UNAME_S}" = "Linux" ]; then cp "${PIPER_LIB}" "${DEST}/libpiper.so" # Locate and copy Linux .so dependencies PHONEMIZE_SO=$(find "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}" -name 'libpiper_phonemize.so' -o \ -name 'libpiper_phonemize.so.1' 2>/dev/null | head -1) [ -n "${PHONEMIZE_SO}" ] && cp "${PHONEMIZE_SO}" "${DEST}/" ESPEAK_SO=$(find "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}" -name 'libespeak-ng.so.1' 2>/dev/null | head -1) [ -n "${ESPEAK_SO}" ] && cp "${ESPEAK_SO}" "${DEST}/" ONNX_SO=$(find "${PHONEMIZE_LIB_DIR}" -name 'libonnxruntime.so*' -not -type l 2>/dev/null | head -1) [ -n "${ONNX_SO}" ] && cp "${ONNX_SO}" "${DEST}/" echo "Copied Linux .so files to ${DEST}" fi
# ── 12. Bundle espeak-ng-data ───────────────────────────────────────────────── ESPEAK_DATA="${PIPER_BUILD}/pi/share/espeak-ng-data" if [ -d "${ESPEAK_DATA}" ]; then mkdir -p "${project.build.outputDirectory}/espeak-ng-data" cp -r "${ESPEAK_DATA}/." "${project.build.outputDirectory}/espeak-ng-data/" echo "espeak-ng-data copied to ${project.build.outputDirectory}/espeak-ng-data/" else echo "WARN: espeak-ng-data not found at ${ESPEAK_DATA}" fi
echo "Piper native build complete"

JEXTRACT="${jextract.home}/bin/jextract" if [ ! -x "$JEXTRACT" ]; then echo "WARN: jextract not installed at ${jextract.home} — skipping Piper binding generation" exit 0 fi HEADER="${project.basedir}/src/main/native/piper_c.h" if [ ! -f "$HEADER" ]; then echo "WARN: piper_c.h not found — skipping jextract" exit 0 fi OUT="${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/jextract" rm -rf "$OUT" "$JEXTRACT" \ --source \ --output "$OUT" \ --target-package com.pairion.nativelib.piper \ --header-class-name PiperBindings \ --include-function piper_initialize \ --include-function piper_load_voice \ --include-function piper_synthesize \ --include-function piper_free_voice \ --include-function piper_terminate \ "$HEADER" echo "Piper jextract bindings generated to $OUT"
